correctness.rationale: Complete scalar normalization gives 9841 equations. Two direct and group-based exact enumerators agree: the independent all-form quartic-discriminant test gives six profiles with counts 144,432,1728,2304,144,432; the exact algebraic Jacobian test on all four affine charts of every representative of 41 projective orbits gives 14 smooth orbits with total 5184. A third direct 1152-element group action recovers those 14 distinct orbit sizes. Squarefree degree-four discriminant of a separable degree-two projection is equivalent to geometric smoothness by the local completed-square double-cover argument; no bounded-extension extrapolation is used. All delivered programs were executed from the packaged paths and agreed.

value.rationale: For a smooth elliptic (2,2) model, the two degree-two projections give distinct degree-two linear systems. The joint Frobenius cycle structure of their four branch points is a natural arithmetic invariant of the pair and distinguishes symmetric and asymmetric ramification structures that the known aggregate smooth-form count cannot determine. The complete six-pattern support and frequencies, notably exactly 144 models with totally split versus two quadratic branches, give a motivated finite-field classification relevant to comparing polarized double-cover models; value is not inferred merely from code or reproducibility.
